subject: Next steps: Private deployment architecture review & calendar availability
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Nguyen <cnguyen@medixcare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + suggested next step (Private/VPC deployment)

Hi Clara —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary goal: run patient-facing summarization and search inside MedixCare’s private VPC with strict data residency and audit logging.
- Expected steady-state QPS: ~40 requests/minute; peak bursts up to ~200/min.
- Constraints: no egress to public buckets, customer-managed KMS, SOC2 evidence needed for procurement.

Next step I recommended on the call: schedule a focused architecture review with our private deployment engineers to validate network/topology requirements, sizing, and rollout plan. That meeting will be ~60 minutes and include an ops checklist and recommended model variants for cost/latency tradeoffs.

Can you share 2–3 windows (next week) that work for your infra and security folks? To make scheduling easier I’ve cc’d Marcus (solutions architect) and Rishi (deployment lead). I’ve attached a short checklist they can review beforehand.

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Tue 10/13 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 10/14 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 10/15 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of those work, drop a preferred time and we’ll align.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-privdeploy-checklist.pdf (PDF, 150KB), networking-requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)

From: Clara Nguyen <cnguyen@medixcare.com>

Subject: Re: Quick recap + suggested next step (Private/VPC deployment)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the clear summary. That aligns with what we discussed internally. Jonas (infra lead) will join from our side.

We can do Wed 10/14 14:00–15:00 PT — that slot looks best for both security and network. If you need anything ahead of time, can you confirm what level of NAT/firewall access your on-prem bundle requires? Also, please include any sample KMS integration notes.

Clara
Head of Product Operations
MedixCare

Thanks Clara — Wed 10/14 14:00–15:00 PT is locked on our side. I’ll lead the architecture review. Agenda I propose (60m):

1) 10m — Introductions & goals
2) 15m — Network & infra requirements (MedixCare to present current VPC/topology)
3) 20m — Deployment options (VPC peering vs. dedicated on-prem appliance), storage and KMS flow
4) 10m — Sizing & latency expectations (token throughput, batching guidance)
5) 5m — Next steps / mutual action items

Pre-reads attached: redwood-privdeploy-checklist.pdf and a short networking template. Clara — on NAT/firewall: for the private control-plane option we only need outbound HTTPS to our control plane endpoints (allowlist), or alternatively an air-gapped push model if you prefer zero egress. I’ll bring the KMS integration snippet to the call.

See you Wed.
Rishi
Deployment Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: networking-requirements.xlsx (template)

Pre-call asks for MedixCare team:
- A diagram of your VPC/subnet layout and any NAT/firewall appliances (one slide is fine).
- The list of security/compliance controls you’ll want covered (SOC2 scope, logging retention).
- Any procurement timelines that could affect rollout windows.

If you prefer a virtual whiteboard instead of slides, we can provision Miro during the call. Looking forward to it.

Regards,
